seo.description: Wedding and event décor rentals in soft whites and sage greens. The Elegant & Timeless Rental Package is $400 with setup included, and delivery is available across Simcoe Muskoka.

title: The finishing
intro: Our décor rentals are curated in soft whites and sage greens for timeless, romantic celebrations. Book the complete package, or ask about individual pieces to mix and match with your own.

items.title: Choose your pieces
items.body: Reserve the Elegant & Timeless package, or tell us which individual pieces you'd like.

items.title: Delivery or pickup
items.body: We deliver throughout Simcoe Muskoka, with a fee based on your location. Pickup is available too.

items.title: Set up for you
items.body: Setup is included with the package. Takedown is available for an additional fee.

items.title: Two-day rental
items.body: Rentals are for 2 days. A damage deposit is required, and every term is in your rental contract.
